run_entries.b2-desktop: NOT RUNNABLE: boot smoke panicked (D7-8); desktop historical comparator is null
notes: --run re-evaluates the whole go/no-go (about 2.5 min cold, the 546-path census hashes large images), claims the token with O_EXCL BEFORE any VM exists, runs once, never retries; a second invocation refuses at the token or at the preflight run_token check.

Inputs were prepared offline already (s107_prepare.py): fixture NVMe disks for the two candidate sets and the glyph oracle under /tmp/cellbox-s10-7/measure/<set>/run-inputs/ (rebuilt glyph sha 820c92d2... == retained GLYPH_SHA); b2-headless needs none.
Each run kills only the QEMU PID it started (machine.proc.pid, retained Machine.stop).

wiring.user_stack: retained observer instance (entry-stop rsp page rounded up; 16 pages mapped; two guard pages verified unmapped by the retained _entry). Cross-checked in s107_memory.discover_user_stack by an independent present-page run below the top with guards absent; mismatch STOPs. B2 tasks accept 16 or 64 pages.
wiring.kernel_stack: read at the entry stop of the task (user mode, first instruction): kernel static CPU_LOCALS[0].kernel_rsp (== kernel_trap_sp == kstack_top-288), symbol address from the measurement kernel .symtab (non-PIE EXEC, no slide), cross-checked with gdt::TABLES[0].tss.rsp0 (+68); top=round_up_page(kernel_rsp), top-kernel_rsp must be 288; usable = the 16 (cand) / 16|64 (B2) mapped pages below top, 2 guard pages below must be unmapped; OWNERSHIP proven by the seeded trap frame still on that stack: sepc(+264)==entry pc and regs[2](+16)==user stack top. Single-hart required (CPU_LOCALS[1].kernel_rsp==0). Any inconsistency or unreadable page = STOP (fail closed).
wiring.heap_arena: cellbox ELF .symtab symbol ___CUSTOM_HEAP_ARENA at inst.base+0x2a8060, 6 MiB (desktop; headless resolved the same way); B2 shell ostd::heap::HEAP_MEM 1 MiB at +0xbc050 (residency only). Symbol must lie inside a PT_LOAD segment or STOP.
wiring.elf_segments: inst.base + PT_LOAD va/memsz (retained observer instance + elf_layout loads).
wiring.prime_proof: verify_primed at the same entry stop: user [bottom, rsp&~4095), kernel [bottom, top-PAGE). The page(s) written by the spawn path before the first instruction (top kernel page with trap frame/switch frame; user page holding the initial rsp) are excluded. A failed proof is recorded (exact=false, depth_valid unaffected unless saturated-unproven); unreadable memory STOPs.
wiring.snapshots: MemoryMixin._snapshot runs the retained mapping snapshot first, then collect() on the focus instance at EVERY retained snapshot name (initial-prompt, ordinary-prompt-idle, finite-stream, collected-cat-buffered, collected-cat-cancelled, terminal-stream-live, terminal-stream-cancelled, rg-cancelled, interactive-top-idle, complete); the feed-hook DISARM request is not a phase and is skipped. Record errors STOP the run (retained convention: snapshot failures are fatal).
wiring.status_row: S10-7.3 select_status replaces Surface.status: desktop = whole-screen rows of the retained command(); headless = the exact-echo-verified echo row + following rows (exact_echo_output re-verifies the echo). Missing/duplicate/ambiguous rows STOP. Deadlines unchanged: 120 s command, 60 s status, 900 s total.
wiring.kernel_provenance: every memory record carries kernel_build, kernel_sha256 (== manifest), kernel_features (contains test-hooks), control-kernel sha, profile, set; MemoryContext refuses a kernel whose sha differs, whose features lack test-hooks, or whose .symtab lacks test_hook_prime_watermark; preflight asserts the control kernel lacks it.
wiring.no_guest_writes: only read_physical_memory/read_memory/read_register are used by the new code (tests use a client that raises on any other call; source scan forbids write primitives). No new breakpoint/watchpoint/step logic: the memory mixin overrides only _entry/_snapshot/write_results; stepping, resume and the one-extra-step recurrence classes are the retained AtomicClient (desktop) / RecurringClient (headless, B2).
wiring.b2: B2MemoryObserver keeps the retained transport/stop loop and 512 slot entry breakpoints but replaces __init__/_handle/_entry/_snapshot: task identity = three 48-byte .text windows per signed B2 ELF (pairwise distinct, relocation-free); the same entry_record() (ranges, ownership check, proofs); shell snapshot at every phase; ls/cat/echo/ps/kill are shell builtins at the B2 commit (executor.rs dispatch_builtin) so typed commands spawn nothing: observed only if a spawn is caught and its stacks are still present.

cannot_be_observed_so_class_is_not_A: User-stack and kernel-stack depth within the pages written before the entry stop (one page each): depth is a lower bound and exact=true only for the pre-run-proven pages below; a stack that never leaves the top page reads as the page floor.
Stack watermark = peak since spawn is a LOWER BOUND (pattern-equal/zero stores invisible); a stray non-0xA5 byte inflates it.

Only the focus Cellbox instance is snapshotted (and the entry proof of the autoload background Cellbox is recorded, never snapshotted). Terminal, vfs, services and any worker/thread tasks are not measured; no pre-run pause exists for their stacks.

Live QEMU physical reads returning identical bytes to the synthetic fixtures is unproven; the entry-stop kernel-record read assumes kernel higher-half mappings exist in the task CR3 (SAS) - if not, the run STOPs at entry (class D).
The vCPU rsp at a pause is not attributable to the focus task, so no sp cross-check is claimed.

B2: allocator peak is NOT measured (no Cellbox heapwatch); desktop B2 comparator is null (boot panic); ls/cat/echo/ps/kill are builtins so their six-tool stacks are not separately observable; no Ctrl-C/cancel/top/rg/pipeline phases (dropped, justified in schedule-b2.json).
Timing from test-hooks kernels is not a startup comparator (per-tick name scan, prime memsets); the boot-time selftest corpus can panic the boot (D7-8 b2-desktop did).

The run argv (retained D.Machine: q35, 256M, 1 vCPU, ISO cdrom + NVMe fixture, no -smp) differs from the boot smokes (-m 2048M, -smp 2 for desktop, virtio qcow2); the hooks kernels have never booted under the run argv (class E/D risk).
